open_issues: W08ScreenshotDiff (tests/Wakeel.E2E) is affected by a compositor-paint race in WSidebar.razor / the app's theme-application startup path (both outside this package's allowed paths): after a full page navigation to /w08, the sidebar can still be painting a stale colour (dark theme's --w-sidebar, or light theme's --w-sidebar-hover) at the exact moment CDP's Page.captureScreenshot reads the frame, even though document.documentElement's data-theme attribute and the sidebar's own getComputedStyle already report the correct light state (getComputedStyle is synchronous with the CSSOM, not with what has actually been painted). This produced a reproducible ~33.97% diff instead of the ~33.30% baseline on roughly half of repeated runs on an otherwise idle machine. Mitigated from tests/Wakeel.E2E/GalleryAndAttentionCenterTests.cs (an allowed path) with a re-check of data-theme plus a fixed 250ms settle wait before capture -- verified 12/12 consecutive runs green afterwards, versus ~50% failing before. This is a timing mitigation, not a source fix; whichever future package touches WSidebar.razor or the theme-application path should look at removing the wait once the underlying race is fixed at the source. Full diagnosis is in docs/build/progress/b2-carryover.md and in a comment directly above the test's Assert.InRange.
